brief:
Hundreds of thousands of children in Gaza have returned to makeshift schools operating in tents, Middle East Eye reported, as the territory grapples with widespread destruction and educational collapse. The resumption of classes comes after three years of conflict that has devastated school infrastructure across the territory.

Overcrowding and severe resource shortages continue to hamper instruction despite the reopening. Destroyed school buildings remain unusable, forcing educators and students into temporary learning spaces that lack basic facilities and materials necessary for effective teaching and learning.
dek: Gaza students return to makeshift schools after three years of genocide Submitted by Nada Nabil on Wed, 09/23/2026 - 08:00 Hundreds of thousands of children attend classes in tents as destroyed schools, overcrowding and shortages continue to disrupt education…
title: Gaza students resume classes in tents after three-year war
